game.label: Your extracted Tokyo Jungle folder, North American PSN release (NPUA80523), with PARAM.SFO and USRDIR inside. Put your license UP9000-NPUA80523_00-TOKYOJUNGLE00001.rap in that folder too.

prepare.label: Building the game from your copy (30 to 60 minutes the first time)

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: 1280 x 720 is the PS3's own and lighter. 2560 x 1440 is sharper, and on a 1080p screen it acts as supersampling.

settings.label: Display
settings.help: Full screen fills any monitor without changing its resolution.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: stdout.log and stderr.log from the last session, for bug reports.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders the game has built, so later runs don't stutter. Clearing only helps if graphics look wrong after an update.
